text: Trace one idea through four chapters by writing the four forms of the same boundary. Fill in the four blanks.
choices: //   Chapter 22, a boundary with nothing behind:  ___
//   Chapter 22, a boundary you cannot cross:     ___
answer: private long cents|List.copyOf(items)|interface Shape { double area(); }|record Point(int x, int y) { }
explanation: Four mechanisms, one purpose: making the code that could break a promise small enough to check. Chapter 35's claim is that this is the book's second idea in four costumes, and that its value is never what is behind the boundary — it is what the boundary lets you stop thinking about.
